title: Auto-apply fees and the default discount still apply to billable work
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the organization has an auto-apply fee template of $10.00 on new work orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with a default discount of 5% and one asset, asset 1.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Work Order.
  2. Pick customer A.
  3. Pick asset 1.
  4. Click Save in the New Work Order window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • Customer A is picked.

Step 3:

  • Asset 1 is picked.

Step 4:

  • The work order opens with the $10.00 fee and the 5% discount.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
